purpose: Independent complexity-weighted audit for command-level evidence. It governs the command-to-mechanics map without shipping internally synthesized guide code as an example or selection weight.

provenance_policy.internal_code_exception_reason: The user explicitly retains the canonical outreg2_xlsx multi-sheet formatter program; no other internally authored implementation is permitted.
provenance_policy.runtime_verified_official_examples: Kept in the separate official-example tool only when manual-linked, explicitly marked as adapted, and verified by a durable Stata run. They are not selector templates or research-usage evidence.
provenance_policy.external_usage_policy: Deposited researcher code remains a separate usage layer. It never replaces command authority and is writable only under the existing exact compatibility and promotion gates.
provenance_policy.test_fixture_policy: Plugin-owned fixtures may contain executable code solely to test policy or runtime behavior; they are never loaded as retrieval evidence.

data.generate_indicator.v1.reason: The two guide atoms differ only in placeholder variable names and implement the same missing-preserving indicator mechanic.

reporting.graph_export_pdf.separate.v1.reason: Both atoms export the active graph to a named PDF with replace; path and comment changes are cosmetic.

reporting.winsor2_pooled_replace.v1.reason: cuts(1 99) is a two-sided replacement and does not demonstrate the declared upper-tail-only state.

official.table_legacy_c_reference.v1.reason: Legacy table ..., c() grammar must not count as modern table one-way statistics coverage.

official.dtable_export_xlsx.v1.reason: The atom demonstrates export persistence and contains no by() grouping mechanic.

official.regress_factor_interaction_clus.reason: Factor-variable interaction grammar is a material command dimension beyond generic clustered OLS.

reporting.outreg2_restored_estimate_appe.reason: Restoring a durable estimate before append is a distinct input-state handoff, not generic active-estimate append coverage.

reporting.outreg2_native_raw_rows.v1.reason: The bounded span states a raw-row policy but does not itself create or verify an omitted/base e(b) state.

table_dtable.reason: Legacy table grammar and dtable export persistence are retained only as supplemental context.

regress.reason: Clustered factor-interaction grammar remains visible as a supplemental mechanic, not generic clustered coverage.

graph_export.reason: A cosmetic duplicate active-PDF export atom was suppressed.

outreg2.reason: Restored-estimate input and raw omitted/base context are separated from generic seed/append contracts.

winsor2.reason: No retained guide atom currently demonstrates an upper-tail-only replacement.
